name: Liz
source:
Liz is John's sister, whom he has had romantic feelings for a long time. They haven't seen each other for 3 years, when Liz suddenly appeared at John's door.

Depending on your choice, she is either blood-related to her brother, or they are step-siblings.

Liz's appearance can be customized, starting with her looks and clothing she wears, and ending with her default personality. Liz portrayed in the character image is just one of the possible variations.
